name: Question 4
problem:
A coolant tank initially holds $500\,\text{L}$ of liquid containing $7\,\text{kg}$ of dissolved anti-corrosion additive.
A solution containing $0.02\,\text{kg/L}$ of dissolved additive is pumped into the tank at a rate of $25\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed liquid is drained out at a rate of $25\,\text{L/min}.$ Which expression gives the amount of additive $Q(t),$ in kilograms, in the tank $t$ minutes after pumping begins?

Question 4
?

A coolant tank initially holds 500L of liquid containing 7kg of dissolved anti-corrosion additive. A solution containing 0.02kg/L of dissolved additive is pumped into the tank at a rate of 25L/min, while the completely mixed liquid is drained out at a rate of 25L/min. Which expression gives the amount of additive Q(t), in kilograms, in the tank t minutes after pumping begins?

a
Q(t)=12−5et/20
b
Q(t)=10−3e−t/20
c
Q(t)=9−2e−t/20
d
Q(t)=−9+16e−t/20
e
Q(t)=8−e−t/20
